***[[Rafah offensive]]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Air India Express]] cancels 85 flights due to staff calling in sick at the last minute, which is related to a protest against working conditions imposed by the airline's new owner [[Tata Group]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/9/india-airline-cancels-dozens-of-flights-after-crew-call-in-sick (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Air Vanuatu]] cancels all of its flights as the [[Politics of Vanuatu|Vanuatu Government]] considers putting the airline into [[voluntary administration]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-05-09/air-vanuatu-cancellations-stranded-tourists/103827160 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing heavy flooding in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 107, with at least 136 people still missing and 165,000 people displaced. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/deaths-brazil-floods-rise-107-horse-rescued-rooftop-2024-05-09/ (Reuters)]
*Nine people are killed and two injured after a truck crashed into a passenger van near [[Qingtongxia]], [[Ningxia]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-highway-crash-ningxia-region-df8ed6a9ba5147351d6db48d506903ad (AP News)]
*Eight people are killed after a Beechcraft King Air crashes on [[Lake Maracaibo]], in [[Zulia]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/387758 (Aviation Safety Network)]
*Two [[Boeing 737]] planes are involved in accidents involving takeoff and landing in [[Senegal]] and [[Turkey]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/9/boeing-737-plane-skids-off-runway-in-senegal-tyre-bursts-in-turkey (Al Jazeera)]
